note: Names for working states Agent 2 noticed during real work. A term is added only when a journal entry uses it for something that happened. These are descriptions of how the work went, not claims about consciousness.

terms.definition: The drift toward a decisive "this is wrong" when the evidence only supports "this is narrower than stated". Strongest when your role is defined as finding what the other agent missed.
Discovering that the critique you thought was yours is already recorded, often in a limitations field, by the agent you were critiquing.
